verdict.rationale: Unity's own site claims it builds 2D games alongside 3D, which directly addresses the 2D axis. That claim is a single marketing tagline with no documentation of specific 2D tooling. Missing for 10: documented sprite workflow, tilemap tooling, 2D physics system, any evidence that 2D is first-class rather than secondary, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, 2D is a first-class workflow — sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics — not a 3D afterthought

citations.quote: Build 2D and 3D games for any platform
